message.content: 如果以主要國際影展或大獎為標準，2020 年最具代表性的「最佳影片」往往被認為是《Nomadland》（《荒野行走》）。該片在 2021 年的第 93 屆奧斯卡金像獎中贏得了最佳影片、最佳導演（Chloé Zhao）以及最佳女主角（Frances McDormand）的三項重要獎項。這些成就使它成為 2020 年度電影界的高峰之一。

According to many sources, the best film of 2020 could be subjective. But we can mention some top films like "Parasite", "1917", "Joker", etc. But maybe they want a specific award winner? For example, the Academy Award for Best Picture went to "Nomadland". So we might say "Nomadland" won the Oscar for Best Picture in 2020. Or we can mention "Parasite" as the first non-English film to win Best Picture at Oscars (but it was 2019). Actually "Parasite" won Best Picture at the 92nd Academy Awards in 2020 for films released in 2019. So for 2020 releases, "Nomadland" won Best Picture at the 93rd Academy Awards in 2021. So the question is ambiguous. We can give a list of top movies of 2020: "Parasite", "1917", "Joker", "Once Upon a Time...in Hollywood", "The Irishman", "Tenet", "Soul", "The Trial of the Chicago 7", "Mulan", "The Invisible Man", "The Gentlemen", "The Hunt", "The Father", "The Little Things", "The Last Duel", "The Midnight Sky", "The King of Staten Island", "The Lodge", "The Call of the Wild", "The Way Back", "The Woman in the Window", "The Devil All the Time", "The Nightingale", "The Last Full Measure", "The Last Letter".

But maybe they want a single answer: "Nomadland" was the best film of 2020 according to the Oscars. Let's respond with that.
